name: retrieve_policy
description: Search the return policy knowledge base and return the most relevant policy excerpts with their source documents. Always pass the customer's country_code so only that country's policy is searched.

query.description: Natural-language question about the return policy, for example: return window for electronics.

country_code.description: Country whose policy applies. One of US, UK or IN. Use the customer's country_code from user_lookup.

number_of_results.description: Optional. Maximum number of policy excerpts to return. Defaults to 5.
